Scope: Static publisher-page, version, licensing, forensic-data and output-effect review of MiTeC Windows File Analyzer and Icon Explorer; no payload executed and no host data opened

WindowsFileAnalyzer.Version: Frozen inventory page version 2.10.0; WFA.exe FileVersion 2.10.0.0, ProductVersion 2.0.0.0.
WindowsFileAnalyzer.PublishedBehavior: Analyzes thumbnail databases (Windows XP, ACDSee, Picasa, FastStone, HP), Prefetch files, shortcuts in a specified folder, Index.dat browser/cookie/temp/history data and Recycle Bin Info2/$I records. Displays results and supports printing.
WindowsFileAnalyzer.CurrentTargetList: Windows XP, Windows 2003, Vista, 7, Server 2008, 8, 8.1, Server 2012/2012 R2, Windows 10 and Server 2016/2019. Publisher list does not claim Windows 11 support.
WindowsFileAnalyzer.CurrentPageLicense: Free for private, educational and non-commercial purposes; commercial license required for other usage.

IconExplorer.Version: Frozen inventory page version 5.3.0; IconExplorer.exe FileVersion 5.3.0.0, ProductVersion 5.0.0.0.
IconExplorer.PublishedBehavior: Browses/searches/manages icon resources in files and libraries, recursively scans a specified path, extracts icons/images/bitmaps and creates 32-bit DLL icon libraries. 16-bit ICL and NE executable support was removed; 32-bit and 256x256 icons are supported.
IconExplorer.CurrentTargetList: Windows XP, Windows 2003, Vista, 7, Server 2008/2008 R2, 8, 8.1 and Windows 10. Publisher list does not claim Windows 11 support.
IconExplorer.CurrentPageLicense: Free for private, educational and non-commercial purposes.

TermsPage.Observation: General MiTeC support EULA states that trial/unregistered freeware is non-commercial. No local owner entitlement or redistribution decision is inferred.

ReviewFindings: Both retained archives and executable member hashes were recomputed and match the frozen inventory.

WFA can expose deleted-file names, browsing activity, user folder paths, timestamps and thumbnail previews when pointed at real artifacts. Print/output behavior and mutation guarantees are not established; do not inspect a live profile or host forensic artifact.

Icon Explorer's recursive path search can reach more files than intended if given a broad root, and extraction/library creation writes output. Preserve source files and use a small synthetic fixture plus a distinct disposable output directory; test collision/overwrite behavior before any broader check.
Both publisher target lists end at Windows 10. These lists do not establish RIDE support for Windows 11 or current Server targets.

MigrationDisposition.Resolved: Pinned versions, publisher-described file surfaces, output effects, licensing and listed target limits are recorded.
MigrationDisposition.Partial: Local entitlement, exact input/output persistence and collision behavior, current-target acceptance, UI and activation remain unverified.
Deferred: Do not read host Prefetch, thumbnails, Index.dat, shortcuts, Recycle Bin records or other user artifacts; do not print or export real-user results.
Later checks must use synthetic disposable files and a narrowly scoped directory, preserve input bytes, use separate outputs and verify cleanup/overwrite behavior.
No Windows 11 or newer Server support follows from the publisher target lists; require applicable RIDE acceptance separately.
MigrationDisposition.EstimateReason: Two product behavior and data boundaries are clearer, but no whole legacy outcome was accepted, retired or excluded; target, license and runtime/recovery gates remain.
